title: Your files, with a little room to breathe.
subtitle: A live, read-only view of this workspace.

messages.content: I want a personal workspace that looks like OpenMuse, with a Next.js interface and the filesystem as its source of truth.

Welcome to Muse Mirror. The folders on disk become your dock. Open one to browse its files, or follow a link below to see a saved conversation, a collection, or a document. Everything you see here comes from a file.

To change this workspace, edit its files in your editor. Add a top-level folder to give it a place in the dock. Change this index.json to update this conversation. The open app checks the disk every 1.5 seconds and reflects your changes.
